rpcs3SettingsInstructionsMD: To retrieve trophies rarity from PSN a personal API token is required. To get your PSN token, go to [www.playstation.com](https://www.playstation.com) and log in to your account. In the same browser (due to a persisted cookie), visit [https://ca.account.sony.com/api/v1/ssocookie](https://ca.account.sony.com/api/v1/ssocookie). You will see a JSON response that looks something like: `{ "npsso": "<64 character token>", ... }`, you can copy the token and paste it below.
rpcs3TrophiesCatPrefixesDescription: Show or hide emoji prefixes (Bronze), (Silver), (Gold) and (Platinum) from achievement name. For some games may need a full System restart to actualize changes.
rpcs3UserPathInstructions: You can find info about your account id by opening RPCS3 and going to Manage > User Accounts.
settingsInstructionsMD: To get your API key, go to [https://retroachievements.org/controlpanel.php](https://retroachievements.org/controlpanel.php) and log in to your account. You should see your api key in one of the entries in that page, you can copy the token and paste it below.
